docs-gates:
python3 -m pip install wavedrom
python3 scripts/check-links.py
python3 scripts/check-matrix.py
python3 scripts/check-integrator-params.py
python3 scripts/render-wavedrom.py --check
make stale
suites:
sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y git help2man perl \
  python3 make g++ libfl2 libfl-dev zlib1g zlib1g-dev autoconf flex bison
git clone --depth 1 --branch $VERILATOR_VERSION \
  https://github.com/verilator/verilator ~/verilator-src
cd ~/verilator-src && autoconf && ./configure --prefix "$HOME/verilator"
make -j"$(nproc)" && make install
export PATH="$HOME/verilator/bin:$PATH"
verilator --version
./scripts/lint_hdl.sh
./scripts/run_suites.sh
python3 scripts/gen_matrix.py --check
export PATH="$HOME/verilator/bin:$PATH"
# PR #13 was squash-merged. Its review lineage is therefore absent
# from main, but remains available through GitHub's durable pull ref.
git fetch --no-tags origin refs/pull/13/head
make -C tb/nvm_port figures
portability:
sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y yosys
curl -sL https://github.com/zachjs/sv2v/releases/latest/download/sv2v-Linux.zip \
  -o /tmp/sv2v.zip && sudo apt-get install -y unzip
unzip -o /tmp/sv2v.zip -d /tmp/sv2v
sudo install /tmp/sv2v/*/sv2v /usr/local/bin/
